_comment: M3 study events (Kimi C, 2026-11-21). Gated by the shared v3 condition path: every event requires an ACTIVE program enrollment (active_enrollment); several narrow to a program via program_ids. Actor-only, all options free, outcome lines carry their context.

events.title: The Vanishing Group
events.text: My group project teammates have gone mysteriously silent and the deadline is a week away.

choices.label: Carry the project yourself
choices.outcome_text: I carried the whole group project alone through the final week; we passed, and I quietly resolved to pick better teammates.

choices.label: Round them up firmly
choices.outcome_text: I hunted down my silent teammates and divided the work with unusual firmness; the project got done by all of us, more or less.

events.title: The Seat Wars
events.text: My usual library seat has been taken by a stranger who is clearly settled in for the long haul.

choices.label: Find a new spot
choices.outcome_text: I gave up my library seat without a fight and found a quieter corner; the new spot turned out to be better anyway.

choices.label: Stare until they leave
choices.outcome_text: I waged a silent staring campaign against the seat thief in the library; they never even looked up, and I studied angry.

events.title: The Dumb Question
events.text: I am completely stuck on this week's material and the tutor's office hours end in twenty minutes.

choices.label: Swallow pride and ask
choices.outcome_text: I swallowed my pride and asked the tutor my 'dumb' question; it was not dumb, and the answer unlocked the whole topic.

choices.label: Struggle alone tonight
choices.outcome_text: I skipped the tutor and wrestled the material alone all evening; I got there eventually, the long way round.

events.title: The Night Before
events.text: The big assignment is due tomorrow and I am further behind than I would like to admit.

choices.label: Pull an all-nighter
choices.outcome_text: I pulled an all-nighter to finish the assignment, watching the sunrise through the window with dry eyes and a submitted file.

choices.label: Sleep and submit what you have
choices.outcome_text: I chose sleep over the all-nighter and submitted the assignment as it was; my body thanked me and my grade might not.

events.title: The Practical
events.text: The practical assessment is today: real equipment, a watching assessor, and no notes to hide behind.

choices.label: Breathe and begin
choices.outcome_text: I walked into the practical exam, breathed, and worked through it step by step; the assessor nodded at the end, which I choose to read as praise.

choices.label: Rush and fumble
choices.outcome_text: I rushed the practical assessment and fumbled the second step; the assessor was kind about it, which somehow felt worse.

events.title: The Bureaucracy
events.text: The education office says my funding forms are 'incomplete', which apparently means three more signatures.

choices.label: Chase every signature
choices.outcome_text: I chased down all three missing signatures across campus in one grim afternoon, and the funding office finally stamped my forms.

choices.label: Deal with it next week
choices.outcome_text: I shelved the incomplete funding forms for next week; the paperwork mountain waited patiently, as paperwork does.

events.title: The Debate
events.text: My class is running a debate and the lecturer has just called on me to argue the side I secretly disagree with.

choices.label: Commit to the argument
choices.outcome_text: I argued the side I disagreed with in the class debate and won the room; my own convictions filed a formal complaint.

choices.label: Flounder honestly
choices.outcome_text: I half-heartedly argued a side I did not believe in during the class debate; the lecturer saw straight through me.

events.title: The Spill
events.text: A practical session has gone sideways and there is a mess on the bench that was definitely not in the instructions.

choices.label: Handle it calmly and safely
choices.outcome_text: I dealt with the spilled practical mess calmly and by the book; the instructor said my cleanup was the best part of my work.

choices.label: Freeze and call for help
choices.outcome_text: I froze at the bench mess until the instructor took over; embarrassing, but at least nobody got hurt.

events.title: The Mid-Placement Review
events.text: My placement supervisor has asked to sit down and talk about how my training is going so far.

choices.label: Ask for blunt feedback
choices.outcome_text: I asked my placement supervisor for blunt feedback in the review and got it; the list was long, but now I know exactly what to fix.

choices.label: Smile and nod
choices.outcome_text: I smiled and nodded through the placement review and learned very little; comfortable, which is exactly the danger.

events.title: The Mid-Course Slump
events.text: Somewhere around the middle of the course, the readings have stopped making sense and my motivation has quietly left the building.

choices.label: Rebuild a small daily routine
choices.outcome_text: I rebuilt a tiny daily study routine to climb out of the mid-course slump; small sessions, kept promises, slowly returning momentum.

choices.label: Coast for a while
choices.outcome_text: I let myself coast through the mid-course slump; the rest did me good, though the readings did not read themselves.

events.title: The Invitation
events.text: A classmate has invited me to join their study group, which meets every Thursday with snacks and ruthless flashcards.

choices.label: Join the group
choices.outcome_text: I joined the Thursday study group and survived their ruthless flashcards; my grades noticed before I did.

choices.label: Politely decline
choices.outcome_text: I politely declined the study group invitation and kept studying solo; quieter Thursdays, lonelier flashcards.

events.title: The Portfolio
events.text: Everything I have learned this course comes down to one final portfolio due by the end of the month.

choices.label: Curate it carefully
choices.outcome_text: I curated the final course portfolio piece by piece, choosing quality over panic; submitting it felt like handing over a piece of my year.

choices.label: Throw it together at the end
choices.outcome_text: I assembled the final portfolio in one frenzied weekend; it passed, but I know exactly what it could have been.
